## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- Module / package:
- Related issue:

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows [Cosmeron Pattern](../Docs/Reference/PATTERN.md).
- [ ] Public names and casing follow the project naming rules.
- [ ] Fallible APIs use the established status/output conventions.
- [ ] Ownership and lifetime behavior are explicit.
- [ ] No unnecessary platform-specific vocabulary leaked into the public API.
- [ ] No new linker requirement was introduced where the zero-link approach is viable.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Relevant documentation was updated.
- [ ] I considered GCC, Clang, MinGW, MSVC, and macOS portability where applicable.

## Notes for review

Call out intentional deviations, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work.
